pass_contract: warning and compromise campaign_id values are identical
evidence campaign is absent from train/validation/calibration/development-reused campaign sets
raw warning, compromise and provenance JSON SHA-256 hashes are recorded

selection_policy: only caller-supplied raw events are eligible; no timestamp or success marker is synthesized
first objective successful-compromise event is the compromise boundary
first valid model warning before that boundary is the lead-time statistic
attack-onset semantics are rejected by the strict V107 validator
if multiple certifiable campaigns exist an explicit campaign_id is required to prevent post-hoc selection
selected raw warning, compromise and provenance JSON objects are copied into an immutable hash-pinned bundle

claim_boundary: Validator and deterministic evidence-bundling machinery are frozen, but no successful-compromise lead-time claim is certified until real model-warning, objective successful-compromise, and disjoint campaign-provenance artifacts satisfy them. Synthetic CI fixtures are never release evidence.

legacy_evidence_excluded.reason: V93 measures lead time to an attack-step/onset boundary. An attack-step/onset timestamp is not an objective successful-compromise timestamp.

repository_audit.audit_conclusion: Engineering support for strict verification and deterministic bundling is complete. The active evidence set still lacks a real paired objective successful-compromise event and model-warning event for one disjoint campaign.

required_for_pass: Select one explicitly identified evidence campaign and prove its identity is disjoint from train, validation, calibration, and development-reused campaign identities.
Record an actual model-emitted warning event with a timezone-aware timestamp and emitted_by_model=true.
Record an objective successful-compromise event for the same campaign with a timezone-aware timestamp, establishes_successful_compromise=true, objective_success_marker, and source_reference.
Run garuda_v3/v110_precompromise_evidence_bundle.py on the raw logs and commit the resulting PASS bundle.
Keep the certified claim scoped only to the exact campaign represented by those artifacts.
